integrity: The proof is symbolic and derives intrinsic degree classes from valuation layers. The verifier replays degree reconstruction and several direct modular-ring graphs; finite checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to finite commutative rings whose quotient by the defining ideal is a finite chain ring of nilpotency length at least three.
The graph reconstructs nilpotency length, residue-field order, and ideal cardinality, not the full ring or quotient isomorphism type.
At nilpotency length two the graph is complete of order |I|(q-1), so residue-field order and ideal cardinality need not be separately recoverable.
A highly relevant 2014 dissertation was inspectable at abstract and repository-metadata level, but its complete theorem text was unavailable through the inspected access path.
title: Ideal-based zero-divisor graphs recover finite chain-quotient parameters
